Dala Grain Holdings JSC
Consolidated Financial Statements
for the year ended 31 December 2025
International Financial Reporting Standards as adopted by the Republic of Kazakhstan
Turan Verity Audit LLP
Kunayev Street 7, Astana, Kazakhstan
Independent Auditor's Report
To the Shareholders of Dala Grain Holdings JSC:
We have audited the consolidated financial statements of Dala Grain Holdings JSC and its subsidiaries
(the “Group”), which comprise the consolidated statement of financial position as at 31 December
2025, and the consolidated statements of profit or loss, changes in equity and cash flows for the year
then ended, and notes, comprising significant accounting policies and other explanatory information.
In our opinion, the accompanying consolidated financial statements present fairly, in all material
respects, the consolidated financial position of the Group as at 31 December 2025, and its
consolidated financial performance and cash flows for the year then ended in accordance with
International Financial Reporting Standards.
Turan Verity Audit LLP, Kunayev Street 7, Astana, Kazakhstan

Note 6 — Segment Information
The Group’s principal operating segment is its grain origination, storage and export subsidiary,
Turkestan Grain Holding JSC (“KGE”). KGE operates elevator facilities across the Turkestan region
with aggregate licensed storage capacity of 480,000 tonnes. Segment results are reported to the
Group’s chief operating decision-maker on a basis consistent with the consolidated financial
statements above; the operational metrics below are provided for context and are not a substitute for
